plainTranslation:
This person can change the way the Sun person sees themselves.

The attraction can feel immediate. The Uranus person may seem different from anyone the Sun person has known before. They may bring a sense of excitement, surprise, and possibility. Around them, the Sun person may feel more awake and more willing to step outside their usual patterns.

The Sun person may also make the Uranus person feel accepted as they are. They may notice the Uranus person's originality without trying to change it.

At its best, this connection is freeing. It can help the Sun person become more independent and more honest about who they are. The Uranus person may bring change into the Sun person's life in a way that feels necessary, even if it is unexpected.

The difficulty is that the Uranus person may need space suddenly. They may pull away, change plans, or resist anything that starts to feel too routine. The Sun person may experience this as rejection, especially if nothing is explained.

This relationship needs clear communication around space. If the Uranus person needs time alone, they should say so directly instead of disappearing. If the Sun person feels unsettled, they should name that without trying to control the other person.

This connection does not need to be conventional to work. It just needs honesty and room to move.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
